method: All 56 saved keys were checked against 正解 markers in their attached transcripts and all matched. Vietnamese explanations include question translation and distractor reasoning. Text choices for questions 86–88 and 89–101 in both exams were restored from transcript lines. Five image/letter-diagram questions remain unresolved because the transcript does not map the depicted choices to answer numbers. Original PDFs and official JLPT keys were not independently checked.

answerKeySource: 正解 markers in stored transcripts; original document provenance not independently verified
